newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank calls for repo bids, rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank calls for repo bids, rates steady.

text.p: The Austrian National Bank said on Thursday it was calling for bids on two-week securities repurchase agreements at a steady rate of 3.0 percent and that it had left its key interest rates unchanged.
Bids have to be in by 0800 GMT on Friday, the central bank said.
Last week, the bank allotted 7.22 billion schillings in two-week repos at three percent, filling six percent of bids.
Austria's discount rate stands at 2.50 percent, its emergency Lombard borrowing rate at 4.75 percent, and its Gomex money market rate at 3.40 percent. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
